scripts.db:upgrade: docker compose up -d postgres && cd backend && DB_HOST=localhost uv run alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:init: docker compose up -d postgres && docker compose exec -T postgres sh -lc 'psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U $POSTGRES_USER -d $POSTGRES_DB -c "DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE;" -c "CREATE SCHEMA public;" -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/S02-db-schema.sql' && pnpm db:upgrade
scripts.db:seed: docker compose up -d postgres && cat docs/specs/S03-test-seed.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres sh -lc 'psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U $POSTGRES_USER -d $POSTGRES_DB'
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run python main.py
scripts.dev:worker: cd worker && uv run python -m app.main
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix app
scripts.check:worker: cd worker && uv run ruff check --fix app
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check app
scripts.lint:worker: cd worker && uv run ruff check app
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:backend && pnpm lint:worker && pnpm lint:frontend
